f4b4bb981e:0feb901cfb361041.title: IT WAS ALL A DREAM
f4b4bb981e:0feb901cfb361041.summary: This artistic project series delves into the exploration of distinct worlds encountered during my recent dreams, expanding upon my imaginative realm and imbuing them with significance through the act of drawing and rendering them tangible in the physical world. This project serves as a testament to the potency of human imagination, emotions, and the fact that even digital abstract artworks acquire profound meaning when crafted from the ground up by a human mind. This is because they inevitably reveal a fragmentary and intimate aspect of my being, simultaneously exhibiting simplicity and intricacy.

f4b4bb981e:53d9d2e3568bee34.title: KEMONO - ?
f4b4bb981e:53d9d2e3568bee34.summary: ?/KEMONO is a personal illustration series inspired by ancient Japanese culture, samurai traditions, and the charm of animal characters. The series reimagines animals such as turtles, rabbits, and orangutan as ancient warriors, each with their own personality, weapons, and distinctive armor. By combining animal characteristics with traditional Japanese warrior aesthetics, KEMONO creates a world where different creatures share the same spirit of courage, honor, and adventure.

f4b4bb981e:d88daee2c511184a.title: Pleto Iconography
f4b4bb981e:d88daee2c511184a.summary: A flexible iconography system designed for Pleto, combining geometric simplicity, visual clarity, and adaptable stroke weights to create a distinctive visual language.

f4b4bb981e:bd447aa6d99768d0.title: Various Illustration. People.
f4b4bb981e:bd447aa6d99768d0.summary: A collection of illustrations exploring the limits of vector illustration and shaping a unique visual style. Focusing on people, fashion and daily life.

f4b4bb981e:12e6423724e1f747.title: Compilation 37
f4b4bb981e:12e6423724e1f747.summary: A new selection of geometric and psychedelic illustrations by YoAz. Bold color relationships, intricate linework and carefully balanced compositions turn familiar shapes into vivid graphic worlds. This collection reflects an ongoing exploration of symmetry, rhythm and visual storytelling through contemporary illustration.

f4b4bb981e:27940173d155d016.title: Cash & Carry
f4b4bb981e:27940173d155d016.summary: A series of illustrated typographic artworks inspired by South Africa's hand-painted shop signage. Drawing on these everyday visuals, the project explores custom lettering through a playful, contemporary lens.

f4b4bb981e:13316ca9cf114d84.title: HOFF Collaboration
f4b4bb981e:13316ca9cf114d84.summary: A capsule collection with HOFF, the sneaker brand from Elche, Spain. I brought my visual language onto their shoes: simple geometric shapes, contrasting colors and a bit of sarcasm. The project covered the sneakers, a T-shirt and a custom box for the limited edition. My favorite detail is hidden inside: the insole carries the first sketch of the collection, the rough drawing where the whole design started.

f4b4bb981e:1b390e3fe9d04fd2.title: Imagination Day 12
f4b4bb981e:1b390e3fe9d04fd2.summary: Imagination Day is a true celebration of creativity ? an event that brings together visionaries, makers, and speakers from around the world. With each edition, its ambition and momentum continued to grow, but the visual identity could no longer keep up with the pace of the industry. That's why we set out to create an entirely new visual language: bold, flexible, and expansive enough to capture the diversity of today's creative landscape. The result is a complete rebrand, a set of fresh visual assets, and a new website that give Imagination Day the energy to move confidently into the years ahead.

f4b4bb981e:54de2ed297e0f28e.title: TONANA
f4b4bb981e:54de2ed297e0f28e.summary: Coatlicue-Tonantzin is the mother goddess of nature, death, and the mother of the gods in the Mesoamerican worldview, particularly within the Mexica tradition. As the archetypal great mother, she embodies the feminine principle that gives life within nature. For this project we worked with interior and furniture designer Andrés Gutiérrez, who?guided by a vivid color palette inspired by Mesoamerican cosmology?selected marbles, volcanic stones, and textured materials for building a bar inspired by the mother goddess of the Mexica pantheon. Within that chromatic range and the primordial creation myth, we developed a graphic identity based on these concepts and on the furniture and interior design created by Andrés Gutiérrez, drawing on elements such as the serpent, femininity, and maternity, as well as Mexican aesthetics associated with the goddess Coatlicue-Tonantzin. To produce the graphic pieces?stationery, the menu, digital applications, etc.?we referenced Mesoamerican codices,.

f4b4bb981e:0c6acecbb865747b.title: GEOTHERMAL LAYERS ? Iceland
f4b4bb981e:0c6acecbb865747b.summary: Abstract aerial studies of Icelandic geothermal terrain, where pale blue water, mineral crusts and altered clay form delicate channels, cracks and layered textures across the volcanic ground.

f4b4bb981e:1b0e0943c04d8fc5.title: BOT
f4b4bb981e:1b0e0943c04d8fc5.summary: A collection of six original artworks, digitally hand-drawn and intended for archival-quality art reproductions. The title establishes a poetic dialogue between the botanical realm and the contemporary digital pulse. f4b4bb981e:f8fcdec4a6402386.title: Sleeping Sheep, Designer Toy Blind Box Concept
f4b4bb981e:f8fcdec4a6402386.summary: This is a series of collectible "blind box" toys I created for the Year of the Sheep. In traditional culture, the sheep symbolizes gentleness, peace, and good fortune?it is the most heartwarming figure among the twelve Chinese zodiac signs. I aimed to capture its tender, soothing nature while incorporating a stylish, contemporary color palette to give the collection a unique, distinctive flair

f4b4bb981e:254b9a80d1857f92.title: Automotive Expressions 2
f4b4bb981e:254b9a80d1857f92.summary: Ongoing exploration of cars through an abstract lens. 2026.

f4b4bb981e:0de3572672987ba4.title: Unreal In My Mind
f4b4bb981e:0de3572672987ba4.summary: I wanted to explore the familiar things around me from a different perspective. Using everyday objects and visual elements from my surroundings as inspiration, I reinterpret and transform their forms into abstract human heads. By rearranging, combining, and reshaping these familiar elements in unexpected ways, I create something entirely different from their original appearance. This project is a personal exploration of imagination, perception, and the unexpected forms that can emerge from ordinary things.

a4977d3fa4:78a31152922e9907.title: New Arrivals From HBX: Moncler
a4977d3fa4:78a31152922e9907.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:78a31152922e9907.summary: Brand Information: Moncler is an Italian luxury brand founded in 1952 by Réné Ramillion in the French alpine village, Monestier-de-Clermont. Over the past six decades, Moncler has cemented itself as a pioneer in the field of functional outerwear. The world-famous outerwear label is especially well-known for its trademark quilted down jackets. In 1968, Moncler designed the professional team uniform for the French alpine skiing team at the Winter Olympics in Grenoble. Today, under the current president and creative director Remo Ruffini, Moncler stands strong as a global lifestyle brand that develops urbane and masculine styles of quilted down jackets, vests, parkas, knit accessories, and even casual wear like T-shirts, sweatpants, and tipped polo shirts. By using patent fabrics and fur details, Moncler injects a modern feel to heritage looks, whilst combining extreme warmth with day-to-day city life. See also Moncler Genius and its collaboration with Palm Angels.Price Range: $350.00 USD - $2,385.00 USDWhere to Buy: Available now on HBX Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:fa642f87dec2be44.title: Alpha Industries x No Problemo Map Mount Kailash Across the CWU-45 Jacket
a4977d3fa4:fa642f87dec2be44.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:fa642f87dec2be44.summary: Summary Alpha Industries and No Problemo reunite for FW26, moving from the MA-1 of their first collaboration to the CWU-45 flight jacketThe sage green jacket keeps the CWU-45’s fold-down collar, high-set pockets and structured shapeGraphics from No Problemo’s “Mount Kailash” collection cover the back, and tonal branding runs along the sleeve Alpha Industries and No Problemo have released the Alpha Industries x No Problemo CWU-45, the second chapter of a partnership that started with a take on the MA-1. Finished in sage green for FW26, the jacket brings the graphic world of No Problemo’s Mount Kailash collection to one of Alpha’s most structured military silhouettes.The CWU-45 was first issued to Air Force and Navy pilots in 1972, and its build is very different from the MA-1 the brands reworked last time. A fold-down collar replaces the bomber’s ribbed neck, the pockets sit higher on the body and the overall cut is more structured. The collaboration keeps all three features, using them as the base for No Problemo’s graphic treatment instead of redesigning the jacket.Most of the change happens on the back panel, where hand-drawn figures, symbols and abstract shapes spread across the full width of the jacket. The artwork comes from Mount Kailash, No Problemo’s FW26 collection, which draws on the myths, geometric patterns and charged atmosphere associated with the 6,666-meter Tibetan peak. Against the muted sage base, the line work reads like a coded map more than a typical back print.The branding is more restrained elsewhere on the jacket. No Problemo’s logo runs down one sleeve in a tonal finish that blends into the base color, while a co-branded patch on the chest marks the collaboration. Alpha Industries’ signature red Remove Before Flight tag completes the jacket and adds the only bright color to an otherwise subdued palette.The Alpha Industries x No Problemo CWU-45 will be available online, via the Alpha Industries store in Frankfurt, Aries, Aries Soho in…

a4977d3fa4:89151523945b3aec.title: Superblue Kyoto to Open in Early 2027 With Landmark James Turrell Exhibition
a4977d3fa4:89151523945b3aec.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:89151523945b3aec.summary: Summary Superblue has announced its first international art center Superblue Kyoto opening in early 2027The venue will inaugurate with a major long-term solo exhibition by Light and Space artist James TurrellLocated directly opposite teamLab Biovortex Kyoto the indigo-clad space will announce full programming details in December Experiential art company Superblue has officially announced the opening of Superblue Kyoto, launching its first international venue in Japan in early 2027 with a major solo exhibition by Light and Space pioneer James Turrell. Situated directly across from teamLab Biovortex Kyoto in the Kyoto Station Southeast Area, the new center expands the Miami-born art platform into Asia with an expansive, long-term survey exploring human perception.surveys the American artist’s six-decade investigation into light as a physical medium from the 1960s through his contemporary practice. Visitors will encounter immersive installations that transform light from an illuminator into the physical subject itself, spanning early works like his 1966 Afrum-Proto projection—which casts the illusion of a glowing three-dimensional cube into a wall corner—to his renowned Skyspaces, Ganzfelds, and research connected to Roden Crater, his monumental naked-eye celestial observatory inside an extinct Arizona volcano.Designed by teamLab Architects, the Superblue Kyoto venue mirrors its neighbor with a distinct indigo-blue exterior, establishing a unified creative nexus within the City of Kyoto's urban revitalization zone. Together with teamLab's largest domestic museum, the two cultural institutions create a walkable district dedicated to large-scale, multisensory contemporary art.Superblue Kyoto is scheduled to open to the public in early 2027, with further details regarding featured artworks and opening dates slated for reveal in December. Take a look at the renderings above. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:8d731f86db687d70.title: Barbour x Paraboot Trade Waxed Canvas and French Leather for FW26
a4977d3fa4:8d731f86db687d70.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:8d731f86db687d70.summary: Summary Barbour and Paraboot reunite seven years after their first collaboration with a Bedale jacket and a Chambord derbyEach piece borrows a signature material from its partner, putting olive waxed canvas on the shoe and Paraboot leather on the jacketA co-branded medallion, leather tassel and Barbour tartan lining connect the two designs Barbour and Paraboot have teamed up again for Fall/Winter 2026, pairing a reworked Bedale jacket with a Chambord derby that each take on materials from the other house. The two-piece capsule is the brands’ second collaboration, arriving seven years after their first, and it focuses on construction and craft rather than a broad product lineup.The capsule rests on a straightforward exchange of materials, with each piece lending a signature fabric to the other so the jacket and shoes read as a matched set. The British waxed canvas goes onto the French footwear, and the French leather moves onto the British outerwear, so neither design is just a logo swap.Paraboot’s piece starts from the Chambord, a flat-top derby the house first made for city wear in Paris over 40 years ago. Its core construction stays the same, with five eyelets, a full leather lining, a Norwegian welt finished with a square-edged welt, and a rubber sole. The upper changes, mixing brown “gringo” nubuck with olive waxed canvas taken directly from Barbour’s jacket language.The finishing details make the shoe clearly a collaboration. A co-branded medallion and a leather tassel, both made specifically for this release, hang from the laces, and Barbour’s classic tartan lines the interior. Every pair comes in a Paraboot box with a matching co-branded tartan dust bag inside.Barbour’s half reworks the Bedale in Oban waxed canvas, given a brushed finish meant to build character over time. The jacket keeps its usual roomy cut, low gusseted pockets and corduroy collar, while Paraboot leather forms the chest pocket and both brand names are embroidered on the lower pockets.…

a4977d3fa4:323425cb50d4b404.title: Clive Christian’s “Uncovered” Perfume Hides a Warm Heart Beneath an Icy Exterior
a4977d3fa4:323425cb50d4b404.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:323425cb50d4b404.summary: Summary Clive Christian unveils "Uncovered," its first transparent perfume, crafted by Elise Pierre.The floral musk shifts from icy aldehydes and eucalyptus to warm immortelle, orris and amber.A sculpted clear glass bottle and ice-block box complete its cold-to-warm story. Clive Christian’s "Uncovered", the house’s first transparent perfume, unfolds like the moment frost gives way to morning light. Selected from 14 competing compositions at the CPL Fragrance House Conference, perfumer Elise Pierre’s floral musk opens with a crisp, almost glacial brightness. Sparkling aldehydes and cool eucalyptus reach the senses first, sharpened by a flicker of pink pepper and lifted by the sunny tang of bergamot. Picture a winter window as the sun breaks through: clean, bracing and quietly inviting a closer look.As that initial chill recedes, the fragrance reveals a warmer core. Immortelle absolute lends a honeyed, sun-dried richness, while powdery orris and creamy ylang oil round out the edges, and a salty accord adds an intimate, skin-close quality. The drydown settles into white musk, sandalwood, moss and amber, glowing slowly like embers seen through clear glass. Composed at a 40% concentration from 164 ingredients, the scent is built around the idea of quiet self-revelation, appearing simple at first impression yet continuing to unveil new layers the longer it rests on the skin.The packaging completes this story of a cool exterior concealing inner warmth. "Uncovered" is presented in a sculpted, crystal-clear glass flacon with nothing to obscure what lies inside, a vessel meant to reflect its wearer as both vulnerable and resilient. Its outer box takes the form of a block of ice, turning the act of unwrapping into a kind of thaw that leads to the treasure beneath.Unveiled as a limited edition for the holiday season, the 50 ml fragrance retails for $500 USD in the US and is available from November 15, 2026 through January 2027, or while stock lasts, at Clive Christian…

a4977d3fa4:8a7c80d2981d9e62.title: Balenciaga Hires Martine Rose & Yeezy Makes Runway Return in This Week's Top Fashion News
a4977d3fa4:8a7c80d2981d9e62.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:8a7c80d2981d9e62.summary: SummaryMartine Rose took the helm at Balenciaga, while Ralph Lauren secured top menswear honors at the 2026 CFDA Awards.Ye announced a Yeezy reboot in Los Angeles, and the 2027 Met Gala revealed a new, everyday-focused theme.Palace detailed its Burberry collaboration, and Joaquin Phoenix debuted smart eyewear with Gentle Monster.Martine Rose Confirmed at Balenciaga' a Day After Piccioli ExitFollowing widespread speculation, Martine Rose was officially named the new creative director of Balenciaga. The London-based designer will oversee all men's and women's collections moving forward. Rose brings her signature subcultural edge to the heritage luxury house, signaling a new shift in Balenciaga's aesthetic trajectory. Her debut collection is expected to hit the runway next season, where she will establish her updated vision for the brand. The appointment arrived only one day after it was confirmed that Pierpaolo Piccioli would step down from the role.Ye Presents Yeezy Season 01 Runway Show in Los AngelesYe presented a brand new Yeezy Season 01 runway show in Los Angeles on the evening of November 4. Art Collaboration Kyoto (ACK) returns for its sixth edition from November 7 to 9, bringing together 63 galleries from 18 countries and regions at the Kyoto International Conference Center. With an expanded international presence and a newly established leadership structure, the 2026 fair continues its mission of fostering cross-cultural exchange between Japan's contemporary art scene and the wider global art community.At the heart of ACK are two signature sections: Gallery Collaborations and Kyoto Meetings. The former pairs Japanese galleries with international counterparts in shared exhibition spaces, encouraging dialogue across artistic practices and cultural perspectives. This year's participants include Tokyo's NANZUKA, which joins forces with New York's Jeffrey Deitch, TARO NASU with Hauser & Wirth, and Tokyo Gallery + BTAP with Seoul's Gallery Hyundai. Meanwhile, Kyoto Meetings spotlights artists and works connected to the historic city, with presentations from galleries including Perrotin, Art Court Gallery, and Kiang Malingue.Beyond the gallery presentations, ACK introduces ACK Intersections, a curated exhibition led by Leonhard Bartolomeus of the Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media (YCAM). Titled Out of Bounds, the program explores the invisible boundaries that shape our relationships with art, architecture, and one another. Featuring works by Ernesto Neto, Efrain Almeida, Piotr Kowalski, and others, the exhibition activates the Kyoto International Conference Center's distinctive architectural spaces. Additional programming includes installations by Aiko Miyanaga, Eriko Mukai, and Ryunosuke Okazaki, alongside a series of conversations featuring…

a4977d3fa4:9fd4ece86fad305e.title: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Returns to IMAX 70mm Theaters This December
a4977d3fa4:9fd4ece86fad305e.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:9fd4ece86fad305e.summary: Summary Universal Pictures will re-release Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey in more than 1000 theaters across the United States and CanadaThe epic was the first film shot entirely on Imax cameras and grossed over 1.8 billion USD worldwideThe film returns to all theatrical formats including Imax 70mm beginning December 11 Film studio Universal Pictures has announced that Christopher Nolan's historical epic The Odyssey will return to theaters nationwide for an expansive theatrical re-release. Starting December 11, the studio will bring the blockbuster back to more than 1,000 screens across the United States and Canada in all formats, highlighted by screenings in IMAX and the coveted IMAX 70mm format.Originally released on July 17, the three-hour historical drama grossed $626 million USD domestically and $1.8 billion USD worldwide, solidifying its place as both Universal's and Nolan's highest-grossing film to date and the second-highest grossing cinematic release of 2026 behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Groundbreaking in its technical execution, the feature stands as the first movie filmed entirely with Imax cameras, generating $550 million USD across IMAX screens globally and setting records for both the highest-grossing IMAX title of all time and the biggest domestic opening in IMAX 70mm history.Based on the ancient Greek epic poem, the narrative chronicles King Odysseus of Ithaca's treacherous journey home following victory in the Trojan War. Matt Damon leads the ensemble as Odysseus alongside Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Zendaya, Lupita Nyong’o, Charlize Theron, John Leguizamo, Elliot Page, and Jon Bernthal, positioning the film as a prime frontrunner ahead of awards season.The Odyssey returns to over 1,000 theaters across the U.S. and Canada in all formats, including IMAX 70mm, starting December 11. a4977d3fa4:378f62d6e316223c.title: Instagram’s Edits App Is Now Available on Mac Desktop for Free

a4977d3fa4:378f62d6e316223c.summary: Summary Instagram is expanding its Edits application to Mac desktop for freeThe software features 4K watermark-free exports and a multi-track timelineBuilt-in publishing eliminates the friction of transferring files to phones for native tagging Instagram is officially bringing its short-form video editing app, Edits, to the Mac desktop. Originally launched last year, the platform has already amassed a footprint of more than 50 million creators currently running the mobile version. Now, the company is scaling up the experience, dropping the desktop application entirely for free. Helmed by Brett Westervelt, who serves as the head of Edits, the move signals a shift in how the platform enables creators to build and finalize visual content. By stepping off the phone and onto the monitor, the software delivers a suite designed for intensive, precision-based production.The Edits desktop application comes fully loaded with a comprehensive multi-track timeline, alongside audio waveforms designed for securing precise cuts. Creators can dial in visuals using keyframes for transitions, while seamlessly alternating between horizontal and vertical video formats. The workspace itself is highly adaptable: users can import custom font files and either build customized keyboard shortcuts from scratch or import mapping from other editing software. To build out the timeline, the desktop version supplies an expansive library of licensed and royalty-free music, stacked alongside diverse sound and video effects. a4977d3fa4:965ab24e5c599321.title: The Headphones That Came With the First Sony Walkman Are Back, Now With USB-C
a4977d3fa4:965ab24e5c599321.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:965ab24e5c599321.summary: Summary Sony’s MDR-3R is a modern remake of the 1979 MDR-3, the headphones that debuted alongside the very first WalkmanThe silver on-ear set reproduces the original’s headband bend, perforated sound holes and “Dynamic Stereo Headphones” marking down to the vintage-style packagingA plug-in USB-C connection, in-line remote and built-in mic replace batteries and Bluetooth pairing entirely Sony is reissuing one of the most important headphones in its catalog with the MDR-3R, a reworked version of the MDR-3 that shipped with the original Walkman in 1979. The silver pair keeps the lightweight, open-air formula that made portable listening possible in the first place, then rewires it for modern phones, tablets and laptops through a direct USB-C plug.To understand why the MDR-3R matters, you have to go back to the cassette era. Sony’s first Walkman, the TPS-L2, arrived with the MDR-3 as its companion, and together the two turned music into something people could carry through the city rather than leave at home on a stereo. The original Walkman launched in Japan in July 1979 and famously featured two headphone jacks so a pair of listeners could share a tape. At a time when most headphones were heavy, studio-style cans, the MDR-3’s featherweight build helped make the whole concept wearable.Sony has treated the reissue with collector-level care. The SONY logo and “Dynamic Stereo Headphones” lettering are precision-finished to match the 1979 model, and the distinctive headband curve and perforated sound holes return unchanged. The rolled side arms from the original are back as well, though here they serve a practical purpose, fine-tuning how the earpads sit against the ear for a more comfortable fit. Even the box and instruction manual adopt the vintage graphic style, and the individual packaging is plastic-free.The earpads are the most playful nod to the past. Both the blue and orange cushions associated with the classic MDR-3 come in the box, and swapping between them…

a4977d3fa4:04e90215897d1e9c.title: Keanu Reeves Is Back as John Wick for the Animated Prequel
a4977d3fa4:04e90215897d1e9c.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:04e90215897d1e9c.summary: Summary Keanu Reeves has closed a deal to reprise John Wick in Lionsgate’s animated prequel filmThe story follows Wick through the Impossible Task, the single night of bloodshed that buys his freedom from the High TableThe prequel joins a growing slate that includes a fifth live-action 'John Wick' and a Caine spinoff starring Donnie Yen Keanu Reeves has signed on to lead Lionsgate’s animated John Wick prequel, returning to the role that rebuilt his action career for a story set before the events of the original film. The project digs into the franchise’s most mythologized chapter, giving fans a first full look at how the Baba Yaga earned his exit from the criminal underworld.The plot centers on the Impossible Task, the feat that turned Wick into a legend among assassins. To break his obligation to the High Table and build a life with Helen, the woman he loves, Wick must wipe out every one of his rivals over the course of one night. Longtime fans will recognize the setup from the 2014 original, where crime boss Viggo Tarasov recounts the story as a warning about the man his son has crossed.Behind the camera, the film pairs a seasoned animation director with the team that built the series. Shannon Tindle, whose credits include Netflix’s Ultraman: Rising and Kubo and the Two Strings, will direct from a screenplay by brothers Ryan and Kaz Firpo. Basil Iwanyk and Erica Lee of Thunder Road and Chad Stahelski of 87Eleven Entertainment return as producers alongside Reeves, with Point Grey also joining the production. Stahelski’s involvement carries particular weight, as he directed all four mainline John Wick films.Lionsgate has been bullish on the format since the project was first unveiled. “In both animation and the world of ‘John Wick,’ the possibilities are endless. And there is no ‘John Wick’ story fans are clamoring for more than the ‘Impossible Task,’” Lionsgate motion picture chair Adam Fogelson said in 2025 when the film was announced.That confidence is backed…

a4977d3fa4:bbf6e0afb9cbcd75.title: Story mfg. and ASICS Send the GEL-TRANSCEND FJ Rambling in Hiking-Blanket Check
a4977d3fa4:bbf6e0afb9cbcd75.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:bbf6e0afb9cbcd75.summary: Name: Story mfg. x ASICS GEL-TRANSCEND FJColorway: Dark Brown, BlackSKU: 1203B194-200, 1203B194-001MSRP: $180 USDRelease Date: November 11 (Story mfg.), November 20 (ASICS)Where to Buy: Story mfg., ASICSStory mfg. and ASICS are back together with the GEL-TRANSCEND FJ, a collaborative sneaker built around the idea of rambling. The UK craft label and the Japanese sportswear giant read the word three ways: wandering with no set endpoint, talking past the point of necessity, and growing somewhere you didn’t plan to. That spirit of curiosity-led movement shapes everything here, from the archival hiking base to a campaign cast of makers and movers photographed on their own turf.The foundation is pure archive. The GEL-TRANSCEND FJ traces back to ASICS’ 1990s catalog of hiking and walking footwear, and the collaborators lean into that outdoor DNA rather than smoothing it over. Rugged synthetic leather overlays wrap the upper, framing panels of Story mfg.’s signature check, a pattern drawn from the woolen blankets that once came standard on old-school hikes. The result splits into two colorways: a black and grey pairing with a cooler, technical read, and a rich brown version that feels closer to forest floor than city pavement.Flip the shoe over and the performance story sharpens. The jagged outsole borrows directly from the GEL-FujiTrabuco 7 trail shoe, bringing a lug pattern tuned for traction, durability and lightweight cushioning onto a lifestyle-leaning silhouette. Story mfg. founder Saeed Al-Rubeyi is clearly sold on it. “The sole is incredible: an aggressive but lightweight tread. a4977d3fa4:e557d0271a7e4fa0.title: TAITO’s ‘Code Geass’ C.C. Plush Stands a Full Meter Tall

a4977d3fa4:e557d0271a7e4fa0.summary: Summary TAITO’s DOQUTE line turns C.C. from 'Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion' into a super-sized plush measuring roughly 100cm tall, 70cm wide and 75cm deepThe figure recreates the white straitjacket C.C. wears in her first appearance, down to the black belts, grey piping and bucklesLift her green hair and an embroidered Geass mark appears on her forehead TAITO is going big with its latest DOQUTE release, a super-sized C.C. plush from Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion that stands about one meter tall. Paired against the white suit, that long green mane gives the oversized figure a striking color contrast from across the room.The DOQUTE Code Geass C.C. super-sized plush is available to pre-order exclusively via TAITO GEAR&GOODS from…

a4977d3fa4:26d365120d6a0f21.title: Martine Rose Is Officially the New Creative Director of Balenciaga
a4977d3fa4:26d365120d6a0f21.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:26d365120d6a0f21.summary: Summary Kering has officially appointed Martine Rose as the creative director of Balenciaga effective November 16Rose succeeds Pierpaolo Piccioli marking the first creative leadership hire under Kering CEO Luca de MeoThe British-Jamaican designer previously consulted on Balenciaga menswear and becomes the second Black woman to helm a major European luxury house French luxury conglomerate Kering has officially confirmed that British designer Martine Rose will become the next creative director of Balenciaga, succeeding Pierpaolo Piccioli. The landmark appointment takes effect November 16, marking a strategic creative pivot for the Parisian house as ownership seeks to revitalize brand momentum and commercial performance.Rose represents the first creative director appointed by Kering chief executive Luca de Meo, who has simultaneously driven creative shakeups across Saint Laurent, McQueen, and Brioni. Her arrival follows Piccioli’s brief tenure after taking over in July 2025 with a couture-focused, romantic approach, which ended abruptly with his departure announced Thursday. Unlike Piccioli, Rose offers a direct connection to the foundational aesthetic forged under predecessor Demna, having previously consulted and shaped Balenciaga’s menswear while building her own label.Founded in 2007, Rose's namesake brand is celebrated for dissecting British subcultures across football, rave, and reggae through an interplay of sportswear and bespoke tailoring. “Balenciaga has always been a house of radical creativity, challenging conventions and redefining the boundaries of fashion. Martine Rose embodies this spirit with a fresh, fearless and deeply contemporary vision,” De Meo stated. The appointment also carries historic cultural significance, establishing Rose as only the second Black woman to helm a major European luxury house following Grace Wales Bonner's menswear appointment at Hermès. a4977d3fa4:5eeaaff88c83fbdb.title: LIV Golf Officially Shuts Down
a4977d3fa4:5eeaaff88c83fbdb.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:5eeaaff88c83fbdb.summary: Summary LIV Golf is officially liquidating operations after failing to secure funding for a planned league rebootExecutives informed a New Jersey bankruptcy judge of the shutdown after BC Partners Credit withdrew a 300 million USD lifelineMarquee golfers including Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau declined to commit to the proposed LIV 2.0 format Breakaway circuit LIV Golf is officially shutting down and liquidating its business operations following the collapse of an eleventh-hour restructuring plan. Executives leading the golf organization’s Chapter 11 bankruptcy confirmed to a U.S. Bankruptcy Court judge in New Jersey that the venture will pivot to full liquidation after failing to secure necessary player commitments.Launched five years ago to challenge the PGA Tour with billions in backing from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, the league sought to upend traditional golf through 54-hole formats, team franchises, and festival-style tournaments. However, LIV faced persistent controversy over its state backing and struggled to attract mainstream television viewership despite broadcast deals with The CW and Fox Sports. The enterprise unraveled after Saudi Arabia withdrew its financial investment, leaving a proposed $300 million USD recapitalization dubbed “LIV 2.0” from BC Partners Credit unfulfilled.The rescue package fell through after marquee golfers refused to commit. High-profile signees including Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau declined to participate in the reboot, with Rahm expressing willingness to accept penalties to return to the PGA Tour. While the venture ends in liquidation, LIV Golf's disruptive run permanently altered professional golf, forcing the PGA Tour to drastically elevate prize purses and overhaul player relations. a4977d3fa4:5cd4a38a8bcec047.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Announces Retirement From Portugal National Team
a4977d3fa4:5cd4a38a8bcec047.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:5cd4a38a8bcec047.summary: Summary Cristiano Ronaldo has officially announced his retirement from the Portugal national team after a 23-year international careerThe all-time leading international goalscorer will conclude his Seleção tenure following the November international fixturesRonaldo leaves the international stage holding world records with 234 appearances and 146 goals for his country Football icon Cristiano Ronaldo has officially announced his retirement from the Portugal national team, bringing the curtain down on one of the most prolific international careers in sports history. The 41-year-old forward confirmed he will officially step away and hand back the number seven shirt following the conclusion of the November international window.Ronaldo's 23-year tenure with the Seleção concludes with 234 appearances and an all-time world record 146 international goals, having captained Portugal to victory at Euro 2016 alongside Nations League titles in 2019 and 2025. “It was not an easy decision, because there are decisions that are not made only with the head. They are also made with the heart,” Ronaldo stated. “If I ever made you happy, if one of my goals ever made you hug someone, forget a worry or feel proud of our country, then it was all worth it.”The announcement follows a 30-day suspension issued by the Portuguese Football Federation following a dispute with manager Jorge Jesus in September. Ronaldo will have two final opportunities to add to his international statistics during Nations League fixtures against Denmark and Wales. In an official tribute, the federation celebrated him as “the ultimate symbol of the soul of our National Team,” while Ronaldo reflected, “I spent my life working to become the best player in the world. Today I realise that my greatest victory was having deserved the honour of representing the best country in the world.” View this post on InstagramA post shared by Cristiano Ronaldo (@cristiano) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:bc32b0edb6c975d5.title: Japanese Tradition Meets Contemporary Style in the Seiko Presage Classic Series
a4977d3fa4:bc32b0edb6c975d5.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:bc32b0edb6c975d5.summary: When streetwear enthusiasts and horology geeks talk about the modern wrist check, the conversation often leans toward high-octane sports chronographs or titanium divers. But there’s a quiet shift happening across both subcultures, where subtle texture, design heritage, and understated versatility are taking center stage.Enter the Seiko Presage Classic Series, a collection that brings traditional Japanese aesthetics into step with today’s lifestyle landscape.At the heart of the Presage lineup is a commitment to expressing traditional Japanese beauty through mechanical watchmaking. Rather than relying on overt branding, Seiko lets the details do the talking. The collection features gracefully curved cases, vintage-inspired multi-link bracelets, and intricate dials that mirror traditional textile weaving and dyeing techniques—from embossed dial patterns inspired by the flowing drape of silk fabric to soft hues like shironeri (refined silk white), wakatake-iro (bamboo green), and sakura-iro (cherry blossom pink).For watch collectors, the appeal of Presage lies in its mechanical integrity and attention to detail. Powered by reliable in-house movements like the 6R51—offering a robust 72-hour power reserve—the series satisfies the technical expectations of enthusiast culture. Features like dual-curved sapphire crystals, and well-balanced proportions (including versatile 36mm, 38mm, and 40.2mm case sizes) make these timepieces a masterclass in horology.Meanwhile, in contemporary fashion circles, Presage hits the sweet spot of the "quiet luxury" and "craft-core" movements. As streetwear evolves past loud logos toward textured layers, muted palettes, and tailored silhouettes, a watch with a subtle, light-catching dial acts as the ultimate understated flex. Whether styled alongside heavy-weight fleece, vintage denim, or a sharply draped coat, these timepieces slide effortlessly into fluid, gender-inclusive wardrobes.To showcase this crossover, platforms like The Presage…

a4977d3fa4:25a7bf239ca97bf4.title: From Couture to Blue Jeans: The Met Pivots to the Everyday for Spring 2027
a4977d3fa4:25a7bf239ca97bf4.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:25a7bf239ca97bf4.summary: Summary The Metropolitan Museum of Art has announced its spring 2027 Costume Institute exhibition extraOrdinary Fashion and the Poetics of the EverydayCurated by Andrew Bolton the showcase explores how designers elevate everyday staples from denim to bubble wrapThe exhibition will open to the public on May 9 2027 following the annual Met Gala the Monday before The Metropolitan Museum of Art has officially revealed its Spring 2027 Costume Institute exhibition, "extraOrdinary: Fashion and the Poetics of the Everyday", establishing the theme for the upcoming Met Gala. The presentation pivots toward quotidian wardrobe staples and utilitarian resourcefulness following the cancellation of the museum's planned John Galliano retrospective.Curated by Andrew Bolton, the exhibition will display between 200 and 230 pieces that investigate how high fashion reinterprets mundane items, spanning blue jeans, plain white T-shirts, and puffer coats to unconventional materials like paper, plastic, and bubble wrap. Archival selections include Charles James’s 1930s couture puffer, Brooke Shields’s Calvin Klein denim, Marc Jacobs’s 1990s Perry Ellis grunge designs, Junya Watanabe’s leather biker silhouettes, and Matthieu Blazy’s trompe l'oeil leather denim for Bottega Veneta.“I wanted an exhibition that I felt had something new to say, and that I felt was relevant to different conversations,” Bolton shared, highlighting how the curation questions notions of value, consumption, and care. Backed by Instagram, Moncler, and Condé Nast, the show engages the tension between necessity and high-end luxury appropriation.The "extraOrdinary: Fashion and the Poetics of the Everyday" exhibition is set to open at The Met on May 9, 2027, preceded by the Met Gala the Monday before. a4977d3fa4:6846d6be2a46e73d.title: Pierpaolo Piccioli Steps Down as Creative Director of Balenciaga
a4977d3fa4:6846d6be2a46e73d.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:6846d6be2a46e73d.summary: Summary Pierpaolo Piccioli will step down as creative director of Balenciaga after serving less than two years in the roleKering chief executive Luca de Meo announced the departure as part of an ongoing restructuring across the luxury group's portfolioLondon-based designer Martine Rose has reportedly been tapped to take over the helm at the Parisian fashion house French luxury conglomerate Kering has announced that Pierpaolo Piccioli will step down as creative director of Balenciaga after less than two years in the role. The departure comes amid an extensive creative restructuring spearheaded by Kering chief executive Luca de Meo across the group's flagship houses.Piccioli took over the Parisian brand following Demna’s transition to Gucci in March 2025, attempting to reconcile couture craftsmanship with Balenciaga’s streetwear credibility. However, reconciling the Roman couturier’s romantic aesthetic with the house's subversive codes proved challenging amidst fluctuating sales. Addressing the transition, Kering noted that "Balenciaga faced a more challenging quarter as the House continued to work through its creative transition and to restore balance across its business.""Pierpaolo is an exceptional couturier and creative talent for whom we have the greatest respect," De Meo said in a statement. "Our ambition is to build on Balenciaga’s avant garde spirit, honour its remarkable heritage and continue to push creative boundaries, further establishing the house as a powerful and relevant voice." The departure follows recent high-profile exits across Kering, including Anthony Vaccarello at Saint Laurent and Sean McGirr at McQueen, with rumors that Martine Rose has been tapped to succeed Piccioli. Kering nor Balenciaga has confirmed Piccioli's successor. View this post on InstagramA post shared by Pierpaolo Piccioli (@pppiccioli) Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:7c409a1e29c86e32.summary: Summary Rockstar’s 'GTA VI' has reportedly generated more than $750 million USD in digital pre-orders weeks before launchAnalytics firm Sensor Tower estimates PS5 players account for 74% of pre-orders, far ahead of Xbox Series X|SThe estimate is already closing in on GTA V’s record first-day sales, though the two figures aren’t a direct comparison Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto VI is reportedly tracking toward one of the biggest launches in gaming history before a single copy has been unlocked. By Sensor Tower’s count, PlayStation accounts for 74% of pre-orders, or roughly 5.74 million copies worth an estimated $559 million USD. Xbox Series X|S makes up the remaining 26%, with about 1.97 million copies bringing in an estimated $192 million USD.The natural benchmark is GTA V, which set a record when it launched in September 2013. Sensor Tower’s numbers are third-party estimates, not sales data confirmed by Rockstar or Take-Two. GTA V’s record, by contrast, reflected actual sales after release, which makes the two figures…

a4977d3fa4:177e4d1c16dff778.title: Valve Is Tightening Steam’s Game Submission Rules After AI-Generated Games Flood the Review Queue
a4977d3fa4:177e4d1c16dff778.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:177e4d1c16dff778.summary: Summary Valve updated its Steam game release rules to clear an approval backlog heavily driven by a surge of AI-generated titlesCurrent review times have stretched to up to 12 business days, missing the platform's standard goal of three to five daysDevelopers must now complete mandatory functionality checks to prevent re-reviews and ease the strain on indie creators Valve updated its Steam game release rules in a targeted effort to unclog a backlog of title approvals. Review times for new games on the storefront now take up to 12 business days to complete. This turnaround contrasts with Valve's operational goal of reviewing new titles within three to five days. The company instituted new guidelines to eliminate constant re-reviews that contribute to longer wait times. Developer 2 Left Thumbs stated on X that review wait times spiked significantly around September and October.The backlog follows a flood of new game titles on the platform, with a large portion created using AI. This influx of AI-generated content strained the review infrastructure at Steam, delaying submissions across the catalog. Reddit user u/ploz found that 49.9 percent of games released on Steam in October officially disclosed AI-generated content. That figure represents a rapid escalation from June, when nearly 20 percent of Next Fest game demos disclosed AI use.To clear the pipeline, the new rules mandate stronger basic quality control at the developer level. Most notably, developers must run their games through Steam for at least five minutes to ensure they function properly on the platform. Valve implemented this after noting that it wasted time reviewing game builds that creators had never played through Steam. Beyond mandatory playtime, developers must confirm common redistributables like DirectX and Visual C++. Creators must also ensure game achievements are ready before release and verify that Steam Cloud save paths are configured correctly. Finally, developers must categorize game…

a4977d3fa4:949005f0afc5a88d.title: 258 Hayao Miyazaki Boards Reveal the ‘Princess Mononoke’ That Almost Was
a4977d3fa4:949005f0afc5a88d.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:949005f0afc5a88d.summary: Summary Iwanami Shoten’s Studio Ghibli-edited image board series reaches Princess Mononoke with its seventh volumeThe book collects 258 of Hayao Miyazaki’s boards, 90 of them published for the first timeA complete “early version” of the story and a closing interview with producer Toshio Suzuki trace how the 1997 film took shape Studio Ghibli and Iwanami Shoten are opening the archive on Princess Mononoke with the seventh volume of the Hayao Miyazaki Image Board Collection. The 184-page edition gathers 258 of Miyazaki’s preparatory paintings for the 1997 film, including 90 that have never been published, and documents the 16-year path from first idea to finished feature.The headline is a version of Princess Mononoke that never reached the screen. Miyazaki’s original concept, which the publisher calls the “early version,” told a very different story about a mononoke spirit and a princess, closer in spirit to Beauty and the Beast, with art that looks nothing like the eventual film. The volume reproduces that full set of early boards together with the complete text of the 1993 picture book Tokuma Shoten published from them, an edition that is now out of print.The rest of the collection shows what happened after that concept was dropped. Miyazaki originally planned to adapt the early version, then shelved it after deciding its theme had grown stale. After making the short On Your Mark, he pushed himself to break from his earlier work, and the boards that follow document that struggle as the story was rebuilt from the ground up. Several images never made it into the finished film, including a rendering of San wearing what looks like a smile, a rare sight for the famously fierce lead.The volume closes with an interview with longtime Ghibli producer Toshio Suzuki, who covers the origins of the ironworks settlement Tataraba, early ideas for Lady Eboshi, and the decision to approach the film with the gritty tone of gekiga comics. a4977d3fa4:2921ecbd0b20fefb.title: Piaget Sets Sodalite and Turquoise Into Its Andy Warhol “Camouflage” Limited Edition
a4977d3fa4:2921ecbd0b20fefb.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:2921ecbd0b20fefb.summary: Summary Piaget and The Andy Warhol Foundation launched the 86-piece "Camouflage" watch.The 45mm white gold cushion case features a dial made of sodalite, turquoise, and gold.The self-winding timepiece honors Warhol’s 1986 self-portraits. Continuing its official partnership with The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts, Piaget has unveiled the Andy Warhol "Camouflage" limited edition watch.Following the "Collage" series last year, this second collaboration draws direct inspiration from a series of self-portraits Warhol created in 1986, which explored the dual nature of fame by obscuring the artist's face behind bold, brightly colored camouflage. Piaget secured the exclusive licensing rights to use Warhol’s name in 2024, renaming the collection - previously known as the Black Tie Vintage since 2014 - to honor the pop art icon, who was a passionate collector and owned seven Piaget models.For this release, Piaget deconstructed Warhol's 1986 self-portraits through the contemporary lens of haute horlogerie. The striking camouflage dial is a masterclass in ornamental stone marquetry, requiring over 100 hours of labor to design, research, and assemble. The abstract pattern is formed from 27 individual pieces, pairing the deep, chromatic blues of cerulean turquoise and oceanic sodalite with the contrasting textures of satin-finished gold and shiny rose gold. Framing this intricate artwork is the model’s iconic 45mm cushion-shaped case, rendered in white gold and detailed with signature gadroons.The Andy Warhol "Camouflage" is powered by Piaget’s self-winding manufacture movement, the 501 P1, driving a set of elegant dauphine hands. Flipping over the white gold case reveals Andy Warhol's famous signature engraved on the caseback, alongside the specific edition number. Production of this highly intricate, art-forward timepiece is strictly limited to 86 pieces worldwide. For more information, head over to Piager's official website or physical boutiques. a4977d3fa4:de62e9814622f88c.title: NikeSKIMS Is Dropping a Waffle Racer Collection, and It Keeps the Original Untouched
a4977d3fa4:de62e9814622f88c.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:de62e9814622f88c.summary: Name: NikeSKIMS Waffle Racer CollectionColorway: Baroque Brown, Light Bone/Varsity Red, Thunder BlueSKU: IW3882-400, IW3882-200, IW3882-002MSRP: $130 USDRelease Date: November 10Where to Buy: NikeSKIMSKim Kardashian and Nike's ongoing NikeSKIMS is taking on the Nike Waffle Racer for its next footwear project, moving from the reworked Air Rift to a far more traditional silhouette. The women’s-exclusive capsule arrives in three colorways and, unlike the partnership’s earlier sneaker, leaves the archival runner’s design almost entirely as it was.The biggest design decision here is a deliberate hands-off approach. Where NikeSKIMS reshaped the Air Rift’s split-toe build to fit its own aesthetic, the Waffle Racer keeps the proportions and construction of the running shoe as it existed in the late 1970s. The result is a capsule built around restraint, giving the collaboration’s fans a version of the shoe that stays true to the original.That restraint puts the focus on color. “Baroque Brown” goes for a deep, earthy look, “Light Bone/Varsity Red” uses a classic collegiate-style contrast, and “Thunder Blue” works in a saturated single tone. Together, the three colorways put the shoe in the same slim, retro-runner territory as the Jacquemus Moon Shoe, a style that has become a regular fixture in fashion-led wardrobes.The collaboration details are deliberately minimal on the shoe itself. Co-branding is limited to the tongue label, leaving the upper free of extra logos or graphics. Most of the special treatment goes into the packaging instead, with a dedicated shoe box, a dust bag and an extra set of laces shown for the release, setting the trio apart from general-release Waffle Racers.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. a4977d3fa4:8fe9cf0ec9ae856b.title: The Tune Squad Suits Up Again in the ‘Space Jam’ x Crocs Classic Clog
a4977d3fa4:8fe9cf0ec9ae856b.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:8fe9cf0ec9ae856b.summary: Name: Space Jam x Crocs Classic Clog “Tune Squad”Colorway: MultiSKU: 214509-90HMSRP: $70 USDRelease Date: November 9Where to Buy: CrocsCrocs is bringing the Tune Squad back to the court with the Space Jam x Crocs Classic Clog “Tune Squad,” a jersey-inspired take on its signature silhouette. The release arrives three decades after Space Jam first hit theaters in 1996, and it’s set to come in both adult and kids’ sizing.The design starts with the uniforms Michael Jordan and the Looney Tunes wore in the film’s climactic game against the Monstars. Those kits were mostly white with red and blue accents, and Crocs follows the same proportions. The clog’s body stays white, while the team colors appear on the trim around the foot opening and along the heel strap.The forefoot carries the most visual weight. Each shoe gets an oversized Tune Squad logo Jibbitz charm that covers much of the toe box, putting the team’s recognizable lettering front and center. Crocs keeps the cast of characters off the upper entirely, so the wordmark carries the theme the way a jersey crest would.The footbeds hold the other main detail. Original Space Jam logos are printed inside each clog, carrying the film’s branding onto the part of the shoe usually reserved for comfort features. With the jersey colors outside and the movie logos inside, every element ties back to the film rather than to any single character.That restraint suits a film whose influence on basketball culture goes beyond its plot. Jordan put Space Jam on screen alongside Bugs Bunny at the height of his fame, and its imagery has become a recurring point of reference in sneaker culture, most notably through the Air Jordan 11 “Space Jam.” At its 30th anniversary, the Crocs version gives fans of the film a lower-key way to wear the Tune Squad colors than a full jersey.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. a4977d3fa4:e04f213678fea830.title: The Nike Mind 002 Flyknit “Black and Anthracite” Has an Official Release Date
a4977d3fa4:e04f213678fea830.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:e04f213678fea830.summary: Name: Nike Mind 002 Flyknit “Black and Anthracite”Colorway: Black/Anthracite/Dark Smoke GreySKU: IR2176-002MSRP: $145 USDRelease Date: November 10Where to Buy: SNKRSAfter getting previewed with only a loose fall window, the Nike Mind 002 Flyknit “Black and Anthracite” now has a confirmed release date, as Nike has officially placed the pair on its launch calendar for November 10. With that date locked, it’s a good moment to look at what this all-dark version brings to the table.The shoe is built on Nike Mind technology, a system that came out of the brand’s in-house Mind Science Department. Twenty-two individual nodes sit in the outsole and move up and down as the wearer walks, pressing into the bottom of the foot in a pattern Nike says science has shown to activate sensory areas of the brain. Nike frames the intended result as a more grounded stride that keeps wearers tuned in to wherever they happen to be.Making that mechanism comfortable takes some careful layering underfoot. A stretchy fabric lines the footbed, giving each node space to travel while still feeling soft against the skin. Beneath it, a soft foam midsole provides plush, responsive cushioning, so the shoe works as an all-day pair rather than a recovery slide you only wear after a session.Up top, the Flyknit upper is what separates this version from the standard Mind 002. Engineered perforations run through the knit to keep air moving, and its layered texture gives the silhouette depth even in an almost entirely dark scheme. Paired with black and anthracite throughout, the now-dated release is the most low-key way yet to fit Nike’s brain-focused footwear into an everyday rotation.Set your reminders and get ahead of what’s dropping next on Hypebeast Drops. d006da4fe3:eea75378d009c570.summary: The United States and China are locked in a global competition to determine who will dominate artificial intelligence and whether it will be democracies or autocracies that set the standards and values of the new digital age. The United States leads the world in the sophistication and power of its artificial intelligence models, and its innovation base and investment in research and development remain unparalleled.But AI competition is much broader than modeling alone. It encompasses a technology ecosystem that includes power generation, servers, and deployment in real-world applications. Jensen Huang, co-founder and CEO of Nvidia, has described the AI industry as a five-layer cake with energy at its base and chips, infrastructure, models, and applications above it. To win the AI race with China, the United States needs to maintain or establish an advantage in each of these layers. And to do that, the United States needs Taiwan.

d006da4fe3:7c8255a6f6b6499e.author: Tatiana Mitrova, Sergey Vakulenko
d006da4fe3:7c8255a6f6b6499e.summary: Tatiana Mitrova, a fellow at Columbia University’s Center on Global Energy Policy and former energy scholar at Moscow’s Russian Academy of Sciences, and Sergey Vakulenko, an oil and gas expert at Carnegie’s Russia Eurasia Center, argue that Russia and Ukraine are locked in an energy war that has become an adaptation spiral, despite growing human and economic costs and despite current US pressure on Ukraine. They observe Ukraine’s remarkable ability to withstand Russian strikes, while questioning claims that long-range Ukrainian strikes will be able to achieve game-changing damage on Russia. Ukraine and Russia have transformed the role of energy warfare in modern conflict, drawing on low costs drones but also new forms of technological resilience that are likely to make wars longer and more dangerous.

d006da4fe3:eca385f8938dab51.title: What Israel’s Election Won't Change
d006da4fe3:eca385f8938dab51.author: Aluf Benn
d006da4fe3:eca385f8938dab51.summary: The constraints and costs of the new security consensus.

d006da4fe3:5ad44315d0de90d6.title: Brazil’s Economic Impasse
d006da4fe3:5ad44315d0de90d6.author: Monica de Bolle
d006da4fe3:5ad44315d0de90d6.summary: Monica de Bolle, an expert in Brazilian economic policy, makes an authoritative argument that Brazil’s economic problems will persist no matter the outcome of the country’s presidential election. A Flávio Bolsonaro administration would fare no better than Lula when it comes to reducing debt and delivering growth—and Bolsonaro’s illiberal policies could make the economic picture even worse.

d006da4fe3:d2da9274feed5e6c.title: A Less-Is-More Strategy for America
d006da4fe3:d2da9274feed5e6c.author: Barry R. Posen
d006da4fe3:d2da9274feed5e6c.summary: Barry Posen, a professor at MIT, is one of America's leading experts on international security. He argues that the United States military is breaking down because it has been overused and overextended over the last 30 years, and that the only way to repair it is for Washington to exercise much more restraint.

d006da4fe3:e407454ddc8200e6.title: How Russia Sees the World Now
d006da4fe3:e407454ddc8200e6.author: Dmitry Adamsky
d006da4fe3:e407454ddc8200e6.summary: Dmitry Adamsky, an expert on Russian security and Russian nuclear deterrence strategy at Harvard and Reichman Universities, examines a large-scale shift in Russia’s strategic thinking over the past year, centered around the view that Europe, rather than the United States, is now Russia’s primary geopolitical rival and adversary, and looking at the consequences of this shift for US efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

d006da4fe3:f2fe497a723c80df.title: AI Is a Choice
d006da4fe3:f2fe497a723c80df.author: Alex Imas, Mohamed A. El-Erian, James Manyika
d006da4fe3:f2fe497a723c80df.summary: Alex Imas, Mohamed El-Erian, and James Manyika, leading voices at the intersection of business and technology, argue that realizing AI’s potential requires giving workers, communities, AI labs, infrastructure developers, and big companies a share of the gains. Using insights from game theory, they argue that increased cooperation can make AI work for all.

d006da4fe3:26bb42beb62831bc.title: The China Price
d006da4fe3:26bb42beb62831bc.author: Zongyuan Zoe Liu
d006da4fe3:26bb42beb62831bc.summary: In 1971, as the international monetary system was on the brink of collapse, U.S. Treasury Secretary John Connally told a group of worried European finance ministers that the dollar was “our currency, but your problem.” The dollar had become that system’s official reserve currency in 1944, under the Bretton Woods agreement, making signatories subject to the whims of U.S. monetary policy. Even after Bretton Woods collapsed and many currencies floated freely, the dollar continued to dominate. In the last half century, U.S. currency power has only expanded, as more countries have integrated into the global economy and therefore grown to depend on the dollar. China, reliant on export-driven growth, is foremost among them.

d006da4fe3:8d3c26580c9ed628.title: Empires of AI
d006da4fe3:8d3c26580c9ed628.author: Niall Ferguson, Lisa Klaassen, Eric Schmidt
d006da4fe3:8d3c26580c9ed628.summary: In this essay, Niall Ferguson, one of the world’s foremost experts on imperial history, teams up the former CEO of Google, Eric Schmidt, and the researcher Lisa Klaasen to make the provocative argument that AI is an inherently “imperial technology”—and to reveal what the fate of past empires might say about the future of U.S.-Chinese competition in a world shaped by AI.

d006da4fe3:c24ab6325d0a2f6c.author: Henry Farrell, Abraham Newman, Yeling Tan
d006da4fe3:c24ab6325d0a2f6c.summary: The search for economic security will end in geopolitical calamity.

d006da4fe3:5932b197c4f8ad1c.title: The Limits of American Power
d006da4fe3:5932b197c4f8ad1c.author: William H. McRaven
d006da4fe3:5932b197c4f8ad1c.summary: William McRaven, a retired four-star admiral and a major figure in American military affairs, uses history and his personal experiences to make an authoritative case that American leaders frequently overestimate the potential of military force to achieve political ends—and that new technologies like AI will exacerbate this problem.

d006da4fe3:33fc15a61a4dba01.title: “Earth Satellites and Foreign Policy”
d006da4fe3:33fc15a61a4dba01.summary: The advent of a new technology invariably comes with strategic implications, raising the question of who will benefit and whether risks can be managed. In 1957, following the Soviet Sputnik launch, U.S. policymakers and analysts recognized that the satellite, as the American physicist and engineer Lloyd Berkner observed in these pages, would bring transformative effects. The United States could not risk losing out, Berkner argued, but nor should governments allow geopolitical tensions to prevent the technology’s broad benefits from emerging.

d006da4fe3:9729d1ab8b25d3aa.title: Europe’s Credibility Gap
d006da4fe3:9729d1ab8b25d3aa.author: Claas Mertens, Ngaire Woods
d006da4fe3:9729d1ab8b25d3aa.summary: Ngaire Woods, Dean of Oxford’s Blavatnik School of Government, Claas Mertens, also at Oxford, have written a piece arguing that Europe, despite its attempts at self-sufficiency, remains dependent on an unpredictable United States. The continent needs to address this vulnerability so that it can convince other countries, many of which find themselves similarly vulnerable to great-power coercion, that it is a worthy partner.

d006da4fe3:09191e7fdf89ba60.title: A Better “America First”
d006da4fe3:09191e7fdf89ba60.author: Charles Kupchan
d006da4fe3:09191e7fdf89ba60.summary: Charles Kupchan, who served in the Clinton and Obama administrations, argues that many aspects of Trump's foreign policy are worth keeping and align with changes in the international system. He explains how the next president can marry the good impulses of "America first" with the best of liberal internationalism.

d006da4fe3:daabdb8037186d1e.title: The Axis of Upheaval Goes to War
d006da4fe3:daabdb8037186d1e.author: Andrea Kendall-Taylor, Richard Fontaine
d006da4fe3:daabdb8037186d1e.summary: Andrea Kendall-Taylor and Richard Fontaine, former members of the National Security Council, argue that the members of what they call the “axis of upheaval”—Russia, China, Iran, and North Korea—are deepening their cooperation. Meanwhile, Washington is creating friction with many of its own partnerships. If these developments continue unabated, the United States will squander the strength of its network just as its adversaries learn to make the most of theirs.

d006da4fe3:960aafc689650ffc.title: The Nuclear Deal That Could Save NATO
d006da4fe3:960aafc689650ffc.author: Ivo H. Daalder
d006da4fe3:960aafc689650ffc.summary: Former U.S. NATO ambassador Ivo Daalder argues that the scramble to shore up Europe's conventional defense risks overlooking the continent's greatest security weakness: nuclear deterrence. Europe knows it can't fully trust Washington's guarantee anymore. But he lays out a middle path between dependence and nuclearization that would extend France's and the United Kingdom's nuclear umbrella—a course, he argues, that could even repair the transatlantic alliance.

d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.title: The Scramble for the Open Seas
d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.author: Michael Albertus
d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.summary: Over the last half millennium, societies around the globe competed to divide up the world’s land. Nearly every square inch of soil outside Antarctica is now owned and tucked within national borders. But the oceans have largely been spared that fate. There were times throughout history when countries tried to gate and regulate the seas, but they were too vast to be controlled for long periods. During the Cold War, as technology made it far easier to imagine partitioning the world’s waterways and seabeds, great powers avoided an unrestrained race to grab the oceans. Most governments agreed to deal with them through a patchwork of treaties and multilateral bodies that sought to guarantee freedom of navigation in international waters and assign coastal seabeds to adjacent littoral states.

fc066e842d:33b974b735b72e1c.title: Intangible Capital as a Source of Economic Growth and Productivity: A Literature Review and Policy Guidelines
fc066e842d:33b974b735b72e1c.author: Rouvinen, Petri
fc066e842d:33b974b735b72e1c.summary: Abstract This review synthesizes the latest scholarly evidence on intangible capital. Drawing on 60 recent studies across macro, meso, and micro levels (anchored by firm-level data from Finland, broader Europe, the US, and Asia) it demonstrates that intangible investments have emerged as the preeminent engine of economic growth, competitiveness, and productivity. The literature yields three critical imperatives for public policy. First, the measurement and statistical tracking of intangibles require a fundamental overhaul; at present, a swath of these investments remains invisible in official data and absent from corporate balance sheets. Second, policymakers must broaden their horizons beyond narrow research and development (R&D) subsidies. Modern innovation policy must embrace the full spectrum of intangible assets – spanning software, data, organizational capital, management capabilities, and brand equity –, while capitalizing on the vital synergies between them. Third, the scalable nature of intangible capital demands a synchronized approach to competition policy, innovation strategy, and corporate finance. Authorities must strike a delicate balance: cultivating the incentives and finance necessary to fuel intangible investments, while simultaneously preventing harmful market concentration and fostering broad diffusion of knowledge.

fc066e842d:ab0dcab8e5d42453.title: Economists, Economic Knowledge, and Central Banks
fc066e842d:ab0dcab8e5d42453.author: Juan Acosta
fc066e842d:ab0dcab8e5d42453.summary: What do economists do in central banks? Why do central banks hire economists? This book investigates the evolving role of economists and economic knowledge within central banks, arguing that their current centrality is neither self-evident nor historically inevitable. While the presence and influence of economists in central banks today may seem natural, this book shows that it is the result of a complex, gradual, and uneven historical process shaped by institutional structures, disciplinary transformations, and shifting relationships between science and policy. Drawing on a rich but dispersed body of literature, the book traces how economists progressively gained authority through the establishment of statistics departments, the adoption of macroeconometric models, and the emergence of a shared cognitive infrastructure between academia and central banks. Rather than focusing on individuals or doctrines, it examines general trends and institutional shifts across a series of national case studies to show how central banks function as boundary organizations, at the intersection of policy and science.

fc066e842d:d77e3040274eaa10.title: From Balanced Growth to Innovation Cycles: A Solow-Type Semi-Endogenous Growth Model
fc066e842d:d77e3040274eaa10.author: Thi Kim Cuong Pham
fc066e842d:d77e3040274eaa10.summary: We develop a growth model with an R&D sector in which the elasticity of innovation with respect to existing knowledge can be negative. We investigate the existence and uniqueness of a balanced growth path (BGP) and derive closed-form growth factors, showing that productivity and output growth are semi-endogenous and population-driven. We also establish the global stability under a general production function. Under testable parameter restrictions, the economy converges to the BGP. However, when the knowledge elasticity is sufficiently low, a Jacobian-based condition implies instability, and an N-period innovation cycle can emerge. Comparative statics are conducted to explore the impact of several factors, including research efficiency, input elasticity, and population growth. Numerical simulations map out transitions and mark the points at which stability is lost. They make clear when innovation frictions endanger balanced growth and provide practical guidance for R&D and demographic policy.

fc066e842d:8c37d1e416ce0b0f.title: Unlocking Firm Innovation in Peripheral Regions: The Critical Role of Local Psychological Openness
fc066e842d:8c37d1e416ce0b0f.author: Obschonka, Martin
fc066e842d:8c37d1e416ce0b0f.summary: Firms in peripheral and less knowledge endowed regions often struggle with innovation, as it is deeply rooted in and influenced by local characteristics. Although recent research highlights the significant, yet complex and hard-to-quantify role of local 'soft factors' such as culture and macro-psychology (e.g., local psychological openness) for firm innovation, we know relatively little about its specific role for firms located in the knowledge periphery. This study examines the hypothesis that favorable local soft factors, such as psychological openness, can compensate for unfavorable local hard factors for innovation of firms located in the knowledge periphery. Drawing upon Schmookler's scissor metaphor, we theoretically elaborate how local psychological openness impacts firm innovation by shaping both the demand and supply sides of the innovation process. In our arguments, we also incorporated the contingent impact of both regional (external) and firm (internal) factors on the relationship between local psychological openness and firm innovation. Our empirical investigation of a large and longitudinal sample of Swedish firms across 2004 to 2018 revealed a compensatory effect of local psychological openness for local 'structural knowledge gaps' in less endowed peripheral regions. Implications for research and policymaking addressing innovation in firms and regions are discussed.

fc066e842d:350e5210b5f57458.title: Knowledge, Power and the Governance of Food System Transformation
fc066e842d:350e5210b5f57458.author: Morgan, Kevin
fc066e842d:350e5210b5f57458.summary: This paper examines how power-knowledge relations shape the mobilization, recognition, and suppression of local knowledge in food system transformation. Drawing on Foucault's subjugated knowledges, we analyse how experiential, place-based expertise encounters institutional resistance within regional governance frameworks. Through case studies from Skåne and Värmland, Sweden, we identify forms of transformative local knowledge, strategies actors employ to sustain them, and mechanisms of their marginalization. Our findings reveal how governance routines, regulatory norms, and national policy agendas constrain transformative potential, while demonstrating how local actors' agency creates alternative pathways for systemic change.

fc066e842d:62bd19b6cddea00e.title: Knowledge for policy in a transformative age: Exploring the structural, operational and practice-oriented characteristics of innovation policy research organisations
fc066e842d:62bd19b6cddea00e.author: Schwaag Serger, Sylvia
fc066e842d:62bd19b6cddea00e.summary: This paper examines the evolving role of universities in transferring and developing knowledge to foster transformative Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) policy amid significant shifts in economic development landscapes. With a rising focus on geopolitics, defense, resilience, and disruptive technologies, universities are increasingly expected to engage and act as catalysts for sustainable development. The research explores how academic institutions interact with policymakers by analyzing "knowledge for policy" relationships, emphasising structural, operational, and practice-oriented factors. Building on a peer-learning exercise hosted by the Governing Resilience and Transformation (GReaTr) initiative in Sweden, the study draws insights from a comparative analysis of five cases of academic institutions, representing diverse contexts and experiences. Findings reveal the challenges universities face in aligning with transformative innovation policies, particularly given the multidisciplinary expertise and agile operational capacities required. Despite evolving practices such as action research and co-created knowledge products, the complexities of addressing urgent and multifaceted policy issues persist. The study concludes by calling for more dynamic and interactive approaches to knowledge creation, stressing the need for universities to adapt their strategies to better engage with policymakers' evolving contexts and demands.
